אֶרֶץ הַכְּנַעֲנִי follows rule 29's arthrous case exactly: the ASV writes two *the*s, so the article morpheme takes the one before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one, with *of* on the rectum (rule 19).
Copulas are placed on the predicates (הָאֱמֹרִי, חִתִּית) while אָבִיךְ and אִמֵּךְ keep only their own English, per rule 20.
